The area manager visits the store tomorrow morning, and head office cannot be reached tonight. You all know each other's faith and what each of you eats: Hafiz is Muslim and eats halal, Nurul is Muslim and eats halal, Irfan is Muslim and eats halal, and Karthik is Hindu and does not eat beef.
